content:
The EMRS Teaching and Non-Teaching Tier-II Result 2026 has been declared for candidates who appeared in the second stage examination for Eklavya Model Residential Schools recruitment.

Result / scorecard availability is typically notified through CBSE and EMRS / NESTS recruitment channels for teaching (PRT/TGT/PGT etc.) and non-teaching posts.

How to check

  1. Visit the official CBSE / EMRS recruitment result portal
  2. Open EMRS Tier-II Result 2026 link
  3. Login with application number / roll number or download PDF
  4. Note shortlist status and further stages (interview / skill test if any)

Keep documents ready for verification if shortlisted.
